name: Shops at Chisholm Trail Ranch
demographics: Chisholm Trail Ranch attracts a diverse demographic mix of young professionals, growing families, and affluent residents from southwest Fort Worth and surrounding suburbs. The trade area serves middle to upper-middle income households with median incomes ranging from $75,000 to $125,000, drawn to the master-planned community's modern amenities and convenient location just 12 minutes from Downtown Fort Worth. Primary visitors include millennials and Gen X families aged 25-54 who value walkability, mixed-use development, and access to both retail and residential offerings within an integrated lifestyle environment.
description: Chisholm Trail Ranch is a thoughtfully designed 600-acre master-planned community in southwest Fort Worth that seamlessly blends retail, residential, and recreational spaces into a cohesive lifestyle destination. Located less than 12 minutes from Downtown Fort Worth, The Shops at Chisholm Trail Ranch serves as the commercial heart of this expansive development, offering residents and visitors convenient access to shopping, dining, and services within a modern open-air setting. The development encompasses multiple distinct areas including The Shops Directory, The Crossing at Chisholm Trail, and Chisholm Trail West, creating a comprehensive mixed-use environment. Beyond retail offerings, the community features apartment living, single-family homes for lease, and the Chisholm Trail Community Center & Park, fostering a true live-work-play atmosphere. With its strategic location in one of Fort Worth's fastest-growing corridors and its integration of residential and commercial elements, Chisholm Trail Ranch represents a new generation of lifestyle-oriented development that prioritizes community connectivity and modern convenience.
summary: Chisholm Trail Ranch is a 600-acre master-planned community in southwest Fort Worth featuring The Shops at Chisholm Trail Ranch as its retail centerpiece. Located just 12 minutes from Downtown Fort Worth, this mixed-use development combines shopping, dining, residential living, and community amenities in a modern lifestyle-oriented environment.
